newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends up in kerb, seen rising.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.07 up at 41.43 to the dollar in the kerb market on Monday amid profit-taking in the U.S. currency, dealers said.
They said the rupee might continue to rise as speculators were booking profits after the dollar rose last week in response to lower adjustment of the rupee by the central bank.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan slashed the rupee to 40.5200/40.7226 against the dollar last Friday from 40.4600/40.6623 fixed on June 28. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.35 percent compared to the previous close at 2.40 percent.- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
